title: Sharp Euler-factor positivity for the BG-rank-refined five-core crank
summary: In this paper, we complete the resolution of Stanton's problem OPAC--005 by proving its fixed-BG-rank assertion. We further establish a sharp nine-factor positivity theorem for the joint generating function. Let $K_{n,j}(z)$ enumerate partitions of $5n+4$ with BG-rank $j$ by the integer five-core crank prescribed in OPAC--005, and put $[5]_z=1+z+z^2+z^3+z^4$. We prove that $K_{n,j}(z)/[5]_z$ has nonnegative integer Laurent coefficients for every $n\ge0$ and $j\in \mathbb Z$.
